title: release record (contract 1.x)
description: What release mode judged, for post-deploy mode to check a deployment against. Written to releases/<candidate>.json in the harness state directory (HARNESS_HOME) and to release-record.json in the run's output directory; release.yml publishes it to the release-records branch. Derived from ReleaseRecordSchema in src/release-record.ts.

candidate.description: The candidate tag that was judged (side b), e.g. 16.3.0-rc.4.

release.description: The release it belongs to: the candidate without its prerelease suffix (16.3.0). A tag that is not a version is its own release.

production.description: The production tag it was judged against (side a), when that had one.

verdict.description: The verdict of the release-mode run.

pinned.description: The candidate's images were pinned by the dispatch's candidate_digests (--b-digests).

verified.description: Every candidate image was pulled from a registry and its signature verified in the run. Only then are the digests evidence of what was judged.

digests.description: app -> the registry digest of each candidate image that had one. Empty when the candidate was not pulled from a registry (built from a git ref, or local).
